title: Payments Product Expert
full_description:
The Payments Product Expert, positioned as Customer Journey Expert (CJE), supports the Business Banking Daily Banking business to drive operational excellence withincurrent account payments,for the recently established area dedicated to Business Customers.
The CJE holds end-to-end responsibility for the development, management, harmonization, and phase-out of products, services, channel formulas, and processes within one or more segments. The goal is to ensure that customers’ payment needs — including SEPA, Target2, SWIFT, Ri.Ba. and local payments — are met with digital-first, seamless experiences.
The CJE helps the product owner to prioritize the backlog activity, to manage internal and external stakeholders, solves impediments, and works with the squad members in their day-to-day activities inpayments landscape.
This role requires strong leadership and communication skills, a problem-solving and data-driven mindset, attention to detail, and the ability to perform under pressure. Advanced expertise in digital onboarding, end-to-end payment processes (both technical and operational), and a solid understanding of UX principles and best practices are essential.
This position also demands ability to work collaboratively in multi-functional teams and global teams.
Key Responsibilities:
Shape and evolve our payment proposition for Business Customers to deliver frictionless, customer-friendly experiences
Plan, develop, maintain, and monitor payment products to achieve income and volume targets
Manage end-to-end payment processes, promoting service digitization
Continuously assess product performance, regulatory landscape, market trends, and competitor activity
Prepare sustainable recommendations for product innovation, improvement, and change
Leverage customer and process insights to suggest enhancements that improve performance and meet customer needs
Build strong, collaborative relationships with stakeholders and colleagues
Represent ING at Group level and externally for payment-related topics
Qualifications and Skills:
+4 years of previous experience in banking or financial services. Payments, operations or technical units would be a strong plus
good knowledge of SEPA regulation (SDD, SCT, SCT Inst), ACH, SWIFT, Target2 and other bank payment processing specific for Business segment
Proven background in building and managing high performance teams
Exceptional knowledge of current account payment processes and products strategy experience and analytics
Extremely customer-focused, continuously in touch with the network, to stay informed of market and industry developments
Strong problem solver and ability to make effective decisions
Ability to analyze and interpret data, using insights to further build direction
Strong communication and presentation skills
Leadership and influencing skills
Ability to negotiate and influence prioritization across all management levels
Experience in working as part of a cross functional leadership team
Ability to work on an international context
Work location: Milan (hybrid)
ING offers many opportunities to build a diverse and rewarding career. You will be joining an international innovative digital bank, the first in Italy to adopt a fully flexible smart working model, and you will be working in a stimulating environment where you can grow both as an individual and as a professional.
